text:
Zoe Park: quick sync — i'm about to merge a tiny PR that changes SDK examples to use `model` instead of `modelName`. thinking through glossary and migration notes. heads up! :wave:
Matt B.: ok — can you drop a short migration snippet in the top of the sdk-migration guide? something like 
```
// old
client.generate({ modelName: 'gpt-x', prompt })
// new
client.generate({ model: 'gpt-x', prompt })
```
would help users a lot.
Kim Rivera: +1. Also need to standardize on camelCase vs snake_case in the docs. right now we have a mix (max_tokens vs maxTokens). i suggest canonicalizing on camelCase for SDK examples and keep snake_case for low-level REST examples.
Zoe Park: agree on camelCase in SDK. i'll add a short note under "Naming conventions" and add a line to glossary about param casing.
docs-bot: Reminder: link check scheduled in 2 hours — broken-link-report will post in #docs when done.
Alex Chen: Zoe — can you add an explicit fallback example showing both names for a week? e.g. show an adapter snippet that maps `modelName` -> `model` so older integrations don't break instantly. like:
```
function normalizeParams(p) {
  return { ...p, model: p.model || p.modelName };
}
```
that helps platform engineers.
Matt B.: good idea. Also check any Quickstart pages — i found one leftover `model_name` in the CLI guide yesterday. i fixed it in a TODO but didn't push.
Zoe Park: i'll sweep quickstart, API reference, and SDK snippets. leaving comments in PR with exact files. if anyone wants to volunteer to review the wording for voice/tone on the migration note i'd appreciate it. tone: short, actionable, minimal fluff. :memo:
Kim Rivera: i'm free to review after lunch. i'll look for phrasing about "breaking changes" and ensure we use "deprecated" consistently (not "old name").
Alex Chen: also suggest adding a line in the glossary: "parameter alias — when a legacy parameter name is supported for a short migration period; canonical name is the single source of truth." keeps us consistent.
Zoe Park: will draft that sentence. i'll also add an inline example that shows both SDK and curl examples side-by-side.
Matt B.: small nit — in docs we should refer to the product as "Redwood Inference" with capitals on first mention, but in code examples we keep lowercase identifiers (redwoodClient). i'm adding a style note to the voice doc.
Zoe Park: thanks. i'm going to merge the rename PR after adding the migration snippet and glossary line. will ping when merged. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Link check complete — 2 warnings, 0 errors. Files: quickstart/cli.md (1), reference/params.md (1).
Zoe Park: nice, will fix those two. leaving an action item list in the PR.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone — ping me if you'd like help with the canonical phrasing for the glossary entry.
Matt B.: short follow-up for release notes: include migration header and example command to replace `modelName`. that'll reduce support tickets.
Zoe Park: added release notes draft to the PR description. merging in ~30m if no objections. :hourglass:
